Question: A 12-year-old female with no past medical history is found to have an abnormal cardiovascular exam during routine physical examination at her pediatrician’s office. Which of the following would would have most likely been auscultated as a result of the pathology on her echocardiogram?

Options:
opa. Increased splitting of S1 with inspiration
opb. Decreased splitting of S1 with inspiration
opc. Normal splitting of S2
opd. Increased splitting of S2 with inspiration
ope. Splitting of S2 in inspiration and expiration
